prompts.avatars: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production avatar sprite atlas for a private family card game called Irish Rummy. Make a 1536x1024 canvas divided into EXACTLY 3 equal columns and 2 equal rows, six 512x512 edge-to-edge square illustrations, NO gaps, NO borders, NO letters. TOP ROW: a red canoe on a lake; a wooden dock pointing onto a lake; a small A-frame lake cabin. BOTTOM ROW: a camping lantern; a sailboat; a ceramic coffee mug. Each square has one simple centered object surrounded by generous empty space for circular cropping, object entirely inside middle 65%. Style: boldly nonphotorealistic flat retro screen-print illustration, vintage 1970s board game artwork and national park poster simplicity. Broad geometric cut-paper silhouettes, charming slightly irregular contours, tiny subtle paper speckling, 4 or 5 flat ink colors per scene, NO gradients or realistic lighting. Cohesive palette pine green, faded teal, warm ochre, burnt orange, buttercream. Distinct useful silhouettes readable at 40px. Restrained adult design, cozy and playful, no faces, no humans, no animals, no shadows modeled in 3D, no photography, no faux realism, no intricate landscape details, no text or logos. Each tile composition framed generously and consistently.
prompts.phone: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a production-quality single iPhone game UI design for Irish Rummy, straight-on full screen app ONLY, 390:844 portrait ratio, NO device frame, no hands, NO photography, no photorealistic textures. Design direction is a restrained vintage 1970s lake-house board game with flat screen-print illustration. Main background flat warm walnut brown #785138 with sparse simplified illustrated grain lines, absolutely NOT realistic wood. Slim top header text '‹ My games' left, 'Sunday at the lake' center and '•••' right. Next row three small circular flat retro screen-print object avatars (red canoe, cabin, sailboat), captions 'Riley' 'Morgan' 'Casey', and tiny '11 cards' each. Below one compact centered line 'Round 1 of 7 · Two sets of 3'. Central generous rectangular deep pine green felt playing mat, simply flat two-tone printed paper grain rather than real fabric, rounded 8px corners. At its upper center a traditional white bordered dark navy crosshatch playing-card deck and white 8 of hearts discard; labels 'Deck' 'Discard'. Preserve familiar real playing-card design; no creative card redesign. Main action strip in warm ivory below mat: bold heading 'Want the 8♥?', smaller 'Riley is drawing. Choose buy or pass.' Two large equal buttons 'Buy 8♥' dark green and 'Pass' ivory with green outline. Small footer 'Buying adds one extra card · 3 buys left'. Final ivory hand tray header 'Your hand · 11 cards' left and '↕ Sort' right, one horizontally scrollable row of traditional playing cards 4 clubs, 6 clubs, 9 clubs, Q clubs, 3 diamonds, 6 diamonds, 9 diamonds, K diamonds. Clear contemporary humanist sans serif all UI, large readable tap controls, crisp screen design, disciplined spacing. No props outside the table, no badge clutter, no illustrations other than the avatars and restrained flat background. Feels crafted, cheerful, sophisticated, quietly retro, not an antique casino, no bevels or glossy realism, no gradients, no neon, no drop shadows beyond one subtle edge. Make a usable legible mobile app concept matching this precise hierarchy.
prompts.wood: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless illustrated background pattern for a retro lake-house card game UI. Square 1024x1024 tile filling the whole canvas. It must obviously look like simplified wood PRINTED ON A 1970s BOARD GAME, hand drawn ink, 2 flat colors total, no realistic woodgrain, no lighting, no gradients, no perspective, no depth, no planks or seams, no knots or circles, no objects, no shadows, no text, no borders.
